metadata.title: fix(ui): Fix MCP Tool Refresh button

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5690a730-1efe-4518-be98-6323b42f37c1

Closes #4082

## 🐞 Root Cause
The root cause is that the button is invoking the `refreshToolsForSelectedGateways` function without the proper `Admin` namespace.

## 💡 Fix Description
Added the `Admin` scope to the JS hook that invokes this function.

## ✅ Checklist
- [X] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [X] No secrets/credentials committed

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
This PR adds comprehensive test coverage for the MCP Tool Refresh button functionality. 
The actual fix appears to have already been implemented in the codebase - the function `refreshToolsForSelectedGateways` is properly exported to the `Admin` namespace and called correctly in the HTML templates.

LGTM 🚀
